events.factual_description: Blues Alley's authorized InstantSeats calendar lists Orquesta Akokán in the Cuban Jazz Series on Saturday, October 10, 2026, with 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM sets. The 7:00 PM set is $60 face value plus a $7 fee and the 9:30 PM set is $50 face value plus a $7 fee. Both exact event pages identify Blues Alley at 1073 Wisconsin Ave. NW, Washington, DC 20007 and state that the performance is co-presented with the Embassy of Cuba. Blues Alley's event copy describes Orquesta Akokán as an ensemble formed with players from Cuban groups including Los Van Van and Irakere and led across its recorded work by producer Jacob Plasse and pianist-arranger Michael Eckroth. The band's official site documents its 2026 album América! as a turn from its earlier 'capital-M Mambo' emphasis toward a broader treatment of migration, loss, Latinidad, American jazz and diasporic memory. Date-specific touring personnel are not published on the verified event surface, so no individual performers are inferred.

en.why_it_matters: This is not just a good Cuban band passing through Georgetown. Orquesta Akokán brings a large, brass-and-rhythm-section mambo language shaped by musicians with Los Van Van and Irakere connections into Blues Alley's close quarters, and the Embassy of Cuba co-presentation gives the date a real cultural-exchange frame. The timing matters too: América! opens that language outward toward migration, diaspora and the conversation between Cuban music and American jazz. Make room for the night if you can.
en.trip_verdict: This is local: pick the 7:00 or 9:30 set and build the Georgetown evening around it rather than turning the date into a travel problem.

es.why_it_matters: No es simplemente una buena banda cubana de paso por Georgetown. Orquesta Akokán mete a la escala íntima de Blues Alley un lenguaje de mambo de metales y sección rítmica construido con músicos ligados a Los Van Van e Irakere, y la copresentación de la Embajada de Cuba le da a la fecha un contexto real de intercambio cultural. Además llega en pleno ciclo de América!, un disco que abre ese lenguaje hacia migración, diáspora y el diálogo entre la música cubana y el jazz estadounidense. Vale hacerle espacio a la noche.
es.trip_verdict: Es local: escogería el set de 7:00 o el de 9:30 y armaría la noche de Georgetown alrededor del concierto, sin convertir la fecha en un problema de viaje.
